text: nina: Heads-up: I'm going to kick off a staged refactor to move /docs -> /docs/v2.1 later today. Breaking the work into 4 PRs: 1) core english material move, 2) redirect map, 3) locale reorganizations (es + de), 4) regenerate SDK examples. Need reviewers and a safe merge ordering. Target first PR at 16:00 PT. omar: +1. Two constraints: the preview infra has been timing out sporadically, and our link-checker flags anchor mismatches in localized files. We should make redirects land before moving locales to avoid churn. ivy: I can take core content move review. I can do a quick pass and leave detailed comments for the followups. @kevin want redirects? kevin: I can own redirects. Quick note: some spanish files changed heading formatting which changed IDs (e.g., `#installation` -> `## Install`). julia: SDK snippets: our lang snippets embed absolute paths in some examples. I'll regen after core move; will also add a small verification that example links are reachable. preview-bot: Preview created for PR 7201: https://preview.redwood-inference.com/pr-7201 (core move). Snapshot: /docs/v2.1/index.html ci-bot: linkcheck failed on PR 7202 (redirects): es/guide/install.md -> anchor \"#installation\" not found. nina: Thanks — adjust plan: Merge order: 7201 (core) -> run quick post-merge anchor scan -> 7202 (redirects) with temporary 302s -> 7203/7204 locales (es/de) -> 7205 (snippets). Use temporary anchor stubs where necessary to keep CI green. omar: Suggest adding tiny HTML anchor stubs at top of affected locale files, e.g.: ``` ``` Remove after everything settled. ivy: OK if we add a clear TODO and a ticket number in the shim comment. Also agree to gate merges to our afternoon merge window (post-20:00 UTC) to avoid APAC tests. kevin: I'll add the shim and a checklist in the redirects PR description: \"TEMP_SHIM - remove once locale headings stabilized\". Will run `yarn docs:linkcheck --only-anchors es/**` locally before marking green. julia: For snippets I'll run: `make gen-examples BASE_PATH=/docs/v2.1` and add `./tools/check-example-links.sh ` to validate. docs-bot: Redirect rules will live in /platform/_redirects-v2.1. Preview updated for PR 7202: https://preview.redwood-inference.com/pr-7202 ci-bot: linkcheck: intermittent network errors on preview host; retried jobs show PR 7201 linkcheck green after 3 attempts. PR 7202 still reports one missing anchor on es/guide/install.md but shim present so can be ignored for now. nina: Assignment recap: ivy -> PR 7201 (core EN), kevin -> PR 7202 (redirects + shims), omar -> PRs 7203 (es) & 7204 (de), julia -> PR 7205 (snippets). Merge order enforced by me: 7201 -> 7202 -> locales -> snippets. Everyone: add \"Merge window: post-20:00 UTC\" to PR descriptions and ping me when green. ivy: I'll aim to approve 7201 by 15:30 PT. kevin: Shim commits pushed to redirect PR with TODO and issue link. Added note to Netlify redirect file showing 302 mapping. omar: Splitting locales into two PRs to keep sizes small; adding anchor checklist to each PR. julia: Codegen run queued. After 7201 merges I'll rebase and run verification against preview snapshot. docs-bot: PR 7201 merged — snapshot: https://preview.redwood-inference.com/snapshot/7201 ci-bot: running site-wide anchor sweep on main; results will be posted as follow-up tasks. kevin: Redirects PR 7202 green after shim; merging now and monitoring canary. docs-bot: PR 7202 merged 1% canary routing active for redirects. Rollback: revert _redirects-v2.1 file and re-deploy. omar: es PR 7203 open. Ran `yarn docs:linkcheck --paths es/**` -> found 2 anchor mismatches; pushing fixes. julia: Rebased snippets PR against main snapshot 7202 and ran `./tools/check-example-links.sh https://preview.redwood-inference.com/snapshot/7202` 12 of 12 example links are 200. Will land after locales. ci-bot: final note: after merges, create a follow-up cleanup PR to remove TEMP shim anchors and update any changed heading IDs. nina: Great work. Let's adopt this flow for future big content moves: core -> redirects (temp 302s + shim) -> locales -> regenerate examples. Document the cleanup step as required. If anything new pops up, post here and we'll pause merges.
